govdocs-archive_org-nsia-CBS-TVNewsSpeci: This CBS News inquiry — ‘The Warren Report,’ Part IV, June 28, 1967 — is a broadcast file on the JFK probe. The network re-examined the commission’s findings. CBS aired the series in 1967. The file belongs to the press archive.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-baptismal-vow: This 1913 reference piece on the baptismal vows — the renunciation of Satan. Joseph Delany explains their solemn weight. I renounce thee, the catechumen cries. The promises bind for life. The Christian's first oath. Their renewal crowns the Easter vigil. Their words are short and solemn.
